profile.headline: Software Engineer @ PostEra

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed frontend and backend software components of a chemical assay request feature for the end-to-end drug discovery platform using React and Django
- Designed and migrated multiple database models and thousands of records using Django ORM

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - Algorithms and Advanced Data Structures (15-351/15-650/02-613)
positions.description:
- Taught graph theory, dynamic programming, network flow, computational complexity theory, etc.
- Conducted office hours to review course material and answer questions

company.name: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science

positions.title: Computational Oncology Researcher
positions.description:
- Implemented SNP, Read Pileups, and Pileups Comparisons stages of a cell-free ChIP-Seq pipeline to process liquid biopsy data.
- Created a hierarchical clustering tool to determine similarity metrics between tumor data.
- Analyzed the feasibility and accuracy of a GC bias correction tool and generated a proof of concept.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on a bioinformatics software testing team that is responsible for verification and validation of software.
- Built an automated tool using Python, Jenkins, and Docker that finds datasets matching specific characteristics in a database, shortening testing time drastically.
- Created an intuitive graphical user interface allowing users to query for data without requiring any knowledge of SQL.

positions.title: Academic and Language Coach
positions.description:
- Advised and supported CMU students in academic skills such as time management, stress management, and organization through one on one meetings. 
- Coached international graduate students in English language speaking skills. 
- Presented workshops to students on academic topics such as procrastination and note-taking.

positions.title: Web Development and Python Course Instructor
positions.description:
- Taught virtual Python Development and Web Design classes to multiple classes of 10+ students.
- Instructed students on how to create websites using HTML and CSS, and basic AWS web hosting using S3. 
- Taught and demonstrated Python coding, including syntax, data structures, recursion, and libraries.

honors.title: First Place Overall - The Tech Challenge

volunteerExperiences.description: Summer counselor and mentor to newer counselors. Responsible for safety, education, and fun of campers.
